record.question: Consider the following statements regarding the expenditure priorities and allocations in the Mizoram Budget 2025-26: (i) The largest portion of the total estimated expenditure is allocated to the Economic Services Sector, which includes flagship schemes like "Mizoram Bana Kaih". (ii) The government has increased the budget for the Health Care Scheme by allocating additional funds from the state's resources, over and above the revenue typically generated from the State Lottery. (iii) The allocation for Power Purchase has been increased, while the allocation for Power Subsidy has been reduced for the fiscal year 2025-26 compared to the current year. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
